note: Hoosier NF recreation area near the Ohio River south of Tell City, built by the CCC: a primitive campground, a small lake with a swimming beach (Memorial Day to Labor Day), and 24 miles of multi-use trail. Hitching racks at the sites, and trail riders use it. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $8, 20 sites, FCFS, no electric, vault toilets. Added year-round, no potable water, 2 pull-throughs, 14-night limit. Fits: every site permits RV, 54 ft+ spurs. Not waterfront stands. Pin good.
flags: WEBSITE: stored is recreation.gov, a listing only (no booking). Agency page: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hoosier/recreation/german-ridge-recreation-area. Phone 812-547-7051 confirmed (Tell City office, open Tue-Thu).

FIT and ACCESS: all 20 sites list RV, Trailer and Fifth Wheel; driveway lengths 54-99 ft. Not a horse camp, though hitching racks and trail riders are there. FS directions: IN 37, IN 70, Gerald Road, German Ridge Road, or IN 66 from Tell City; no warning on the road, no surface stated. No closure on it among the FS alerts ('Peninsula Trail', 'Tipsaw Trail Bridge', 'Tower Ridge Road' are elsewhere).
STATUS: FS 'Site Open'; 'Beach area closed until next spring' is the seasonal beach, not the campground.

WATER: not waterfront stands. recreation.gov's per-site points centre on 37.9510,-86.5888 (the stored pin), and imagery within 350 m shows woods and pine blocks, no water. The lake is at the day-use area toward the FS point 37.95514,-86.58117, about 800 m ENE of the sites (distance from coordinates; I did not plot the shore, Overpass timed out).
Interagency discount: the page doesn't speak to it, left inherited.
